verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents subscribable outbound webhooks across many event types: configuration, payment method, transfer, dispute, negative balance, report, payment events and network-token lifecycle. It also documents relayed authorisation webhooks sent to your own servers, configured in the Customer Area. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of webhook signing/verification and retry/delivery guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can subscribe to the following webhooks: Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning, Report
These webhooks inform you when a merchant initiates a payment, and when funds have been added to or deducted from balance accounts.
Adyen sends webhooks for events in network token lifecycles.
When we receive a payment authorisation request, we send you a relayed authorisation webhook with the relevant transaction data, including transaction rules and validation checks.
